title: The confirm-blocks gate counts from when the log is processed, ignores removed (reorged) logs and re-reads unpinned latest state; the LP baseline snapshot is not read at one block either

evidence.note: triggerBlock = getBlockNumber() at scheduling time; logEvent.blockNumber is not used
no check of logEvent.removed before evaluating

evidence.ref: grep -n "removed" over the ANTIRUG snapshot (slice-files.ts --snapshot ANTIRUG)
evidence.note: no read of a log removed property anywhere in the slice (the matches are comments and log text only)
V2 re-reads at latest, not at the confirm block (V3 :1685)
getBlockNumber, then getReserves and totalSupply in separate calls; the stored snapshot_block may not be the block the values came from (V3 :137-140)
block events come from a 4 s poll and are emitted once per block number, so the gate fires at the first poll at or after confirmBlock
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Confirmation delay never verifies that the triggering event survived a reorg
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): Baseline reads are not pinned to their recorded snapshot block

sibling_sites_checked: All block-number uses in the slice: detector.ts:1013, :1234, :1263, :1845, :2107, lpBaseline.ts:110, raceTelemetry.ts:158 (dead code). A reorged-out removal is self-correcting in practice because the gate re-reads live state, which no longer shows the removal.
severity_rationale: S3: the confirm delay is longer and less precise than configured, and a removed log is processed as new, but every decision re-reads live state, so a reorged-out removal does not trip. No capital effect found.
recommendation: Count confirmations from the log block, skip logs with removed set, and read the confirm-block state with a block tag; take the baseline values and the block number from one block. Phase 29.
